sections.changelog: v1.2.108: Fixes the review issues from v1.2.107. CSS Studio now uses the compact MV panel with its editor sidecar beside it. Media Studio collection counts include detected folder-plugin folders, local MV collections are labelled and draggable from an explicit handle, sub-collections use a modal workflow, folder-plugin collections are clearly marked as detected/read-only for hierarchy changes, Bricks media insertion closes the picker, and media conversion status is tied to the exact selected asset. Content Studio inputs now match button height, Edit in Studio starts reliably, CSS Recipes uses a centered studio width, toast countdown rings animate cleanly, and Builder Tools floating handles/structure rail visibility are stabilized.
